claim_one_line: THE DECADAL REVIEW NOW CERTIFIES DOCUMENT CURRENCY, ROOM BY ROOM. The protocol had six steps -- suite green, gates green, atlas fresh, promotion-candidacy sweep, framing and stale-leads sweep, dated report -- and EVERY ONE CHECKS ARCS OR GATES while NONE checked whether the documents a reader forms their picture from still describe the programme, which is why ROADMAP_TOE.md stated the position as the kinematic/symmetry frame is forced arithmetic for a MONTH after B862/B863/B864 falsified it and THE_SM_VERDICT.md shipped omitting ELEVEN OF TWELVE cascade arcs, both surviving multiple reviews. STEP 7 ADDED IN FOUR PARTS, none optional. 7a MECHANICALLY FIRST: scripts/checks/doc_currency.py runs and ITS OUTPUT IS PASTED INTO THE REVIEW REPORT including every frozen opt-out and every DECLARED_DEBT WITH ITS AGE, and a debt older than two reviews is ESCALATED BY NAME -- a debt is not an exemption, the direct lesson of B982 where seven gate exemptions rested on an audit that never mentioned them. 7b BY READING, ROOM BY ROOM: seven rooms each with the one question the report must ANSWER rather than assume -- claims (superseded, retracted, or scoped wider than proved?), the chain (can a reader follow philosophy to aAbB to the object to faces/family/both rows to the algebra to the cascade to symmetry breaking and gauge groups WITHOUT A GAP?), the negatives (is every we-do-not-have-X still a claim with a citation?), method (does this describe how we ACTUALLY seal, verify and certify TODAY?), speculation and philosophy (is the firewall still one-way and does the motivation still match the mathematics?), interpretation and easy-read (can a new reader, human or agent, reconstruct the work from these alone?), and logs. 7c THE NAMED-CHAIN CHECK: every waypoint the owner named must be confirmed findable and current with the THIN ones RECORDED RATHER THAN HIDDEN, and today-s check is written into the protocol -- eleven well covered, MARKOV BLANKET at ZERO arcs and in NO document carrying a CONFLATION HAZARD since the corpus is saturated with Markov TRIPLES which is a different object, and FEEDBACK MECHANISM at 2 arcs, both now ladder rungs X31/X32. 7d THE STANDARD AND THE CLAUSE THAT MAKES IT REAL: whoever opens this repository, human reviewer or AI seat, can follow the complete chain of work and arrive at the current state WITHOUT BEING MISLED BY ANY DOCUMENT IN IT -- and A REVIEW THAT CANNOT ASSERT THAT NAMES WHAT BLOCKS IT, which is the operative sentence because it forbids a review from passing SILENTLY over a stale room, exactly how a wrong roadmap survived a month of reviews. SCOPE: governance not mathematics, proving nothing about the object; and it is a READING obligation -- 7a is mechanical but 7b-7d are judgement whose quality belongs to the reviewer, so what the protocol guarantees is that the judgement is MADE AND RECORDED, not that it is correct. The currency measure behind 7a is deliberately crude (newest-citation lag): a document can be current while citing nothing recent, or stale while citing a fresh arc -- it is a prompt to read, not a proof of staleness.
